title: Residential Electricity Supply: Computing the Restored Dual-Fuel Credit
content:
**Computation.** The restored dual-fuel credit for one missed cycle of a Residential Electricity Supply agreement is the per-cycle dual-fuel credit of the electricity plan in force on the agreement, rounded half up to the cent. The per-cycle dual-fuel credit is the figure the dual-fuel and renewal loyalty credit rate card states for that plan; the plan in force is the plan recorded on the agreement when the credit is restored.

**Assembly and rounding.** The amount is carried at full precision until the end. A multiplier acts on the per-cycle dual-fuel credit together with any uplift added to it; flat additions are added to that product; the total is rounded half up to the cent only once, at the end. The amount is entered as a positive figure and posted as a negative credit line on the restored cycle.

## Worked figures (hypothetical agreements)

| Plan in force | Per-cycle dual-fuel credit | Restored credit for the cycle | Posted line |
|---|---|---|---|
| a plan whose rate-card figure is 3.00 USD | 3.00 | 3.00 USD | minus 3.00 USD |
| a plan whose rate-card figure is 5.00 USD | 5.00 | 5.00 USD | minus 5.00 USD |

**Single rounding, illustrated (hypothetical totals).** A total of 3.5049 USD before rounding gives a restored credit of 3.50 USD; a total of 3.505 USD gives 3.51 USD.

**Points of reading.**

- The plan in force is the one recorded on the agreement on the restoration date, read from the agreement record.
- Each missed cycle is computed on its own and posted as its own line.
